checks.name: One tracked project manifest
checks.evidence: The repository has one named project manifest and no legacy config source.

checks.name: Shared bounded project boundary
checks.evidence: CLI and Studio share one strict browser-safe parser; Node and native adapters own file access.

checks.name: Native selection and activation boundary
checks.evidence: Native input is bounded and symlink-aware; validation and activation are separate operations.

checks.name: Packaged file association
checks.evidence: The local macOS app bundle owns one exported .antiky editor association.

checks.name: Launcher and active project identity
checks.evidence: A cold start shows Open project; an active workspace shows name, manifest, schema, and root.

checks.name: User documentation
checks.evidence: The dedicated Projects guide covers Studio, Finder, manifest identity, safe rejection, CLI use, and migration.

checks.name: Actual native usability evidence
checks.evidence: The receipt and five native captures prove launcher, settings, picker, identity, keyboard, safe rejection, and Finder behavior.

commands.name: Studio app contracts
commands.evidence: All portable Studio, launcher, project-manager, and native-adapter contracts pass.

commands.name: Native host contracts
commands.evidence: All Tauri configuration, picker, file-event, project-boundary, terminal, and Rust contracts pass.

commands.name: Local macOS app bundle
commands.evidence: The release macOS .app and its web payload build with the .antiky association.

commands.name: Repository checks
